text: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613836. Select the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units. Source data from the assays, activities, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures tables. Join assays to activities on assay_id, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by assays.chembl_id equal to CHEMBL1613836. Return all matching rows.
